# ignifx-probes

## Light probe file (`ignifx/light-probe-file`)

A regular grid of baked light probes: first-order spherical harmonics of the diffuse light at each probe.

| Field | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `str` | `"ignifx-probes"` | Always "ignifx-probes". |
| `formatVersion` | `u32` | `1` | The file format version; 1 before ignifx 1.0. |
| `origin` | `vec3` | `{"x":0,"y":0,"z":0}` | World position of probe (0, 0, 0). |
| `cellSize` | `vec3` | `{"x":1,"y":1,"z":1}` | Distance between neighbouring probes per axis, in metres; positive. |
| `counts` | `vec3` | `{"x":1,"y":1,"z":1}` | Probes per axis, whole numbers from 1; counts.x at most 1024, counts.y × counts.z at most 4096. |
| `coefficients` | `array` | `[]` | 12 linear-RGB floats per probe (c0, c1, c2, c3; diffuse light for normal n is c0 + c1·n.y + c2·n.z + c3·n.x), X fastest, then Y, then Z. |
